SC-001.title: External call before balance update
SC-001.rationale: external call before state update -> possible REENTRANCY
SC-001.recommendation: Apply checks-effects-interactions: update state BEFORE the external call, or use OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard.

SC-002.title: Unchecked low-level call
SC-002.recommendation: Capture and check the boolean: (bool ok, ) = ...; require(ok);.

SC-003.title: Unchecked send
SC-003.rationale: return value of .send() ignored -> silent failure
SC-003.recommendation: Check the return value of .send() or prefer .call with a require, using checks-effects-interactions.

SC-004.title: Delegatecall requires review
SC-004.rationale: A delegatecall is present. The rule does not establish that its target is attacker-controlled.
SC-004.recommendation: Trace target control, upgrade authorization and storage compatibility before adjudication.

SC-005.title: tx.origin authorization
SC-005.recommendation: Use msg.sender for authorization; tx.origin is phishable.

SC-006.title: selfdestruct requires review
SC-006.rationale: A selfdestruct expression is present; its chain-specific effects have not been checked.
SC-006.recommendation: Review reachability, authorization, asset flow and the target chain's execution semantics.

SC-007.title: Legacy compiler declaration
SC-007.recommendation: Upgrade to a current 0.8.x compiler (built-in overflow checks).

SC-008.title: Missing compiler pragma
SC-008.rationale: missing Solidity compiler pragma -> compiler version is not pinned
SC-008.recommendation: Add a pinned pragma, e.g. `pragma solidity 0.8.24;`, so the contract cannot be compiled with an unexpected/older compiler.

SC-009.title: Block-data randomness candidate
SC-009.rationale: Block data occurs in a contract containing randomness-related terms; data flow is unverified.
SC-009.recommendation: Trace the randomness source and adversarial influence over outcomes and asset payouts.

SC-010.title: Caller-controlled callback
SC-010.rationale: The source calls a method on an interface derived from msg.sender. This may be attack-side code.
SC-010.recommendation: Inspect both sides of the callback; do not infer that an external victim is vulnerable.

SC-011.title: Predictable game outcome
SC-011.rationale: winner is derived from player-supplied parity -> predictable game outcome
SC-011.recommendation: The second player can read the first player's number on-chain and pick a winning parity. Use commit-reveal so choices are hidden until locked in.

SC-012.title: Ownership change requires review
SC-012.rationale: A function matches the ownership change requires review rule; verify its intended behavior.
SC-012.recommendation: Restrict state-changing/ownership functions with an access-control modifier (e.g. OpenZeppelin onlyOwner/RBAC).

SC-013.title: Timestamp-sensitive logic
SC-013.recommendation: Avoid exact timestamp assumptions; use safe time windows and do not use timestamps as randomness.

SC-014.title: Asset transfer requires review
SC-014.rationale: A transfer occurs without a guard recognized by the rule. Legitimate payouts may match.
SC-014.recommendation: Review intended permissions, recipient selection, preconditions and business invariants.

SC-015.title: Potential unbounded iteration
SC-015.rationale: A function matches the potential unbounded iteration rule; verify its intended behavior.
SC-015.recommendation: Bound iteration counts, paginate work, or use pull-based processing.
